blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.content:
\setcounter{equation}{0}

The classical Fourier transform is a powerful tool  in the Harmonic analysis
 on the simple Lie groups and  
homogeneous spaces. In the quantum group case similar problems can be 
simplified by the Fourier transform in the quantum affine space. There exist
a few papers devoted to the quantum Fourier transform \cite{CZ,M},
 but their main object
is the quantum algebra of operators without specification of the spaces of
functions where these operators are defined. For this reason, applications of
 those results in concrete problems of Harmonic analysis are not so easy.

Abstract
We consider functions on the lattice generated by the integer powers of q2 for
0 < q < 1 and construct the q-analog of Fourier transform based on the Jackson
integral in the space of distributions on the lattice.
